digest.component_or_area: plan review verdict routing and degradation handling
propositions: A malformed repository criteria configuration causes plan_review_assemble_criteria to raise CriteriaError, but the generic workflow interpreter records only the exception string, losing typed failure identity.

Gate dispatch routes every unrecovered workflow failure through _degraded_plan_review_verdict, which unconditionally stamps llm_unavailable=true even when no LLM/batch frame executed and the failure originated from criteria assembly.

The config-fault verdict must carry the same deterministic findings as the degraded path, report a distinct config_fault field without llm_unavailable, and provide actionable diagnostic naming the installed rebar build as suspect.

Genuine LLMUnavailableError failures must continue emitting llm_unavailable=true unchanged; structured CriteriaError identity must be preserved from assembly boundary and documented in step output contract.
